item.title: v1.2.2
item.description:
### New - **An update you won't miss.** Once a new version has downloaded, a "New update available" button stays in the toolbar, and "Install Update…" in the Xylem menu, until it's installed. One click shows what's new and installs it. Before, a single notification was easy to miss while Xylem stayed open for days. - **What's new after an update.** The first launch after an update installed on quit shows its release notes once.
### Improved - The panel button in the toolbar is now as tall as the other buttons. - The About window is simpler: no site link, and even spacing.

item.title: v1.2.1
item.description:
### New - **A loader while a tab starts.** A new tab, or Xylem opening with your tabs, shows a small spinner and "Starting Claude Code…" instead of a blank terminal, until Claude draws its first screen. If your shell asks you something while it starts, the terminal shows it right away.
### Improved - **One notification per thing Claude does.** Resizing the window or opening a side panel no longer sends the same "Claude finished" again. A turn Claude starts on its own (a background task reporting back) finishes quietly unless you wrote something since; `/goal` still tells you when it's done. - The About window is shorter (licenses stay in Help > Open-Source Licenses), and its copyright year follows the calendar.
### Fixed - A tab stopped with Esc could be reported as finished about a minute later.

item.title: v1.2.0
item.description:
### New - **Intel Macs and macOS 15.** Xylem now runs on macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. - **Select and copy in Files and Changes.** The file preview and the diff select like an editor: drag across lines, double-click a word, Cmd+A, Cmd+C. A copy is just the code, without line numbers, +/- markers or hunk headers. Cmd+F searches them. - **Doctor fixes your PATH.** When Claude Code is installed but your shell can't find it, the Doctor shows one command for your shell (zsh, bash, fish, csh) that adds it to the right startup file. It checks again when you come back to Xylem and offers to restart the tabs where Claude couldn't start. A red Doctor opens its details by itself.
### Improved - **Closed tabs give their memory back** and end whatever was running in them. - **Big files in the drawer** no longer leave hundreds of MB behind after you close them. - Folder pickers are reused instead of piling up memory.
### Fixed - Cmd+C with a Cyrillic (or other non-Latin) layout copied and also typed "с" into Claude. Cmd shortcuts now act like on the US layout. - A folder name with #, ? or % showed cut or changed in the window title and tab. - New Worktree could hang forever when the repository's git hook printed a lot or left a process running. - A git command that never finishes, or a special file in place of a project's settings, could freeze parts of Xylem.

item.title: v1.1.0
item.description:
### New - **Files and Changes.** A row of icons at the right edge of the window: Claude and Git switch the right panel, Files and Changes open a drawer over the terminal. Browse the project's folders with a read-only preview, or see every changed file in a folder tree with its diff. Drag a file from the drawer or Finder onto the terminal to type its path for Claude. - **Syntax highlighting** in file previews and diffs, for about 50 languages. - **Open files in your editor.** Settings > Files picks the app the drawer's Open button uses (VS Code, Zed, Xcode, a JetBrains IDE or any other app). The first Open asks once. - **More shortcuts.** Ctrl+Cmd+1-4 for Claude, Git, Files and Changes, Cmd+O opens a folder from any tab, Ctrl+Cmd+S shows or hides the tab list. Change them in Settings > Hotkeys; Cmd+/ lists them all.
### Improved - **Settings in six tabs:** General, Claude Code, Terminal, Files, Hotkeys, and Updates & Privacy. - **Right panel:** opens and closes at once, can be made wider or narrower by dragging its left edge, and keeps its sections open while hidden. Its text is a little softer, so it doesn't outshine the terminal. - **Updates are checked every hour** instead of every few hours. - **Toolbar:** more room inside the capsules, and Usage and the panel button are now separate. - The View menu says "Show Tab List" or "Hide Tab List", whichever it will do.
### Fixed - Doctor no longer turns amber for a tab where you answered "No, exit" to Claude Code's "trust this folder?" question. - A dropped or inserted path that contains control characters is refused instead of being typed into Claude.

item.title: v1.0.4
item.description: ### Fixed - **Project names.** Projects that have no saved sessions showed wrong names and paths: a folder like `billing-api` appeared as `api`, under a path that doesn't exist. Xylem now finds the real folder on disk, whatever its name (dashes, dots, spaces or non-Latin letters). - **Smoother scrolling** through a long Recent Projects list: every card has the same height now ("No sessions" for a project without any). - **Dates.** After a week, recent projects and sessions show the day ("Oct 20", or "Oct 20, 2025" for earlier years) instead of "20/10/26".

item.title: v1.0.3
item.description:
### New - **Send crash reports switch.** Settings > General > Privacy lets you turn crash reports off (they are on by default and take effect after a restart). Reports never include your prompts or project names.
### Improved - **Recent Projects fill the window.** The New Tab screen shows as many full rows of projects as fit on your screen, with a "Show more" tile at the end when there are more. - **No more piles of empty tabs.** New Tab takes you to a tab that is still waiting for a folder instead of opening another one. - **Full first prompt on hover.** In the Sessions list, hovering a session shows its whole first message, not just the first line. - **Hover feedback** on tabs, the tab close button, Open Folder, Command Palette, All Sessions and Doctor. - **Cleaner prompt search.** Cmd+K no longer lists prompts from temporary folders left behind by other tools. - **Tidier welcome screens.** The Resume button names the project instead of quoting your last prompt, and the New Tab screen sits higher with less empty space. - The Settings window opens centred on the screen and fits the General tab without scrolling.

item.title: v1.0.2
item.description: ### Improved - **Cleaner project lists.** Projects that live in temporary folders (left behind by tools that run Claude Code once per task) no longer fill Directories, Recent Projects and Sessions. Usage still counts what they cost. - **Clearer folder prompts.** When macOS asks whether Xylem may open your Desktop, Documents, Downloads or an external or network drive, the prompt now says why: Claude Code and the shell in your tabs need it to work with your projects there.

item.title: v1.0.1
item.description:
### New - **Worktree button.** The strip under the terminal has a Worktree button: a new branch in its own folder, opened in a new tab (the same as Cmd+K "Git · New Worktree Tab…"). It is greyed out, with the reason in its tooltip, when the tab's folder isn't a git repository. - **Help > Open-Source Licenses.** A window with every open-source library inside Xylem (SwiftTerm, Sparkle, the Sentry SDK), what each one does and its full license. The About window is short again: the website and the library names.
### Improved - In a narrow window the bottom strip shows icons only, with the names as tooltips, instead of cutting its labels short.

item.title: v1.0.0
item.description:
### New - **Automatic updates.** Xylem checks for a new version every few hours, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. Xylem > Check for Updates… shows what's new and can install it right away; Settings > General > Updates turns the automatic check off. - **Crash reports.** If Xylem crashes, it sends a report so the bug can be fixed: the error, macOS version, Mac model and Xylem version - never your prompts, files or IP address. - **Estimated costs are marked.** A model Xylem doesn't have a price for yet is priced like the newest model of its family, and the Usage dashboard now says so: an "estimated" tag on its row and the estimated part under Total Cost.
### Improved - Right panel: section arrows before the titles, clearer headers, and Claude/Git and This project/All switches across the full width. The panel refreshes by itself; Cmd+K "Refresh Sidebar" is still there. - Settings > General fits without scrolling.
### Changed - Xylem now runs on Apple silicon Macs only (M1 or newer).
